# P36.3 — The ATE technology concept in the ontology (ACQ-03: `ate` family + `GeometryKind`/`geometry_kind`)

**Requirement ids:** **SIG-ONTO-019/020/022/052/052a/053/056** (three-level `domain → family → technology`; every family carries an `-unspecified` leaf; family-discriminator slugs; the §13.1 counts asserted against the generated artifact; every term carries the criterion/signature/salience triple) · **SIG-GEO-003** (the asset model MUST NOT assume point geometry — the `area` member makes an area-shaped record declarable) · **SIG-ONTO-066/067** (a predicate is registered through the ontology, never invented at emit) · **SIG-ENG-003/039** (spec amendment through `spec_src` + `BUILD.sh`; Appendix F row lands with the ADR). **No new requirement id minted** — the count amendment rides SIG-ONTO-052/052a.
**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/276_P36.3__ate-technology-concept.md` (manifest row 276) · **Base:** `r11/P35.15b-technology-backfill` (`371fa2d6`) · **Branch:** `r11/P36.3-ate-technology-concept` · **OM-20 posture:** none — engineering-only; no production mutation, no hosted write, no fetch, no rights/ingestion flip, no gate ticked. Live legs: none.

## Why

The wave-B plan's ACQ-10 rows are 15 automated-traffic-enforcement targets with rights/access ready but no technology concept: `traffic_camera` is the deprecated blanket type (downstream emit is forbidden to use it) and the `alpr` discriminator does not cover signal/speed/stop-arm triggers. P36.4 also needs a record to *declare* an area shape — the closed sink (P35.14a) would quarantine an unregistered `geometry_kind` id.

## What ships

- **`ate` family under `surveillance-vehicle`** (`ontology/vocab/technology.yaml`): six active leaves — `ate-red-light`, `ate-speed`, `ate-bus-lane`, `ate-school-bus-stop-arm`, `ate-work-zone`, `ate-unspecified` — every leaf with distinguishing criterion, evidence signature, salience; counts → **14 / 37 / 110** (40 retired unchanged).
- **`GeometryKind` enum** (`common.yaml`): `point` | `line` | `area` — the record-declared geometry shape kind; an ATE zone or programme area is `area`, never a device point.
- **`geometry_kind` predicate** (`predicates.yaml` row 281): `single`, `SLOW`/2y/`authoritative_source_wins`; directness `camera_registry` D1, `connector_run` D3, rest D6 — P36.4's `geometry_kind="area"` and P36.6's zone rows pass the closed sink.
- **ADR-207** + Appendix F row + regenerated ADR index; **spec amendment** (SIG-ONTO-052 → 14/37/110, domain row, §11.5 echo) through `spec_src` + `BUILD.sh` — byte-identical rebuild; manifest `## Spec amendments applied` records it.
- **Generated artifacts** (`make gen`) committed: SKOS hierarchy `ate-* → ate → surveillance-vehicle`, `predicate_registry.json`, `vocab_summary.json`, JSON schema/OWL/Pydantic/docs.
